<subagent sessionID="ses_e538e920bffeTfHbJGnRQMQG9H" state="completed">
## Repository findings

- **Framework:** No application framework or game engine is present in the tracked repository. There’s no `package.json`, source directory, or existing game implementation, so the stack is open.
- **Current state:** This appears to be a bare OMGithub/OpenCode scaffold rather than a working game. `README.md` links to the hosted project, but contains no implementation details.
- **Run/test commands:** `start.sh` delegates to an external runtime script at `$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/default-start.mjs`; `capture.sh` similarly delegates to `default-capture.mjs`. The repository does not define install, build, or test commands. `Agents.md` mentions a Pascal development server at `http://localhost:3002` for browser capture, but that server’s code is not in this checkout.

## Suggested direction

Build a self-contained, mobile-first 3D game—such as a compact obstacle-dodging or arcade-runner game—with a clear goal, short replayable rounds, score/best-score tracking, and restart flow. Use responsive touch controls alongside keyboard controls, keep the HUD and gameplay within phone/tablet safe areas, and make the core loop work without external assets or services. A browser-based Three.js implementation would fit the repository’s available guidance, but there’s no existing stack to preserve.
</subagent>

content.text:
Built **NEON//DRIFT**, a playable, mobile-first 3D-perspective arcade runner in `index.html`.

- Dodge sentinels, collect flux shards, and chase your distance record.
- Play with touch buttons, tap/swipe, or keyboard controls (←/→, A/D).
- Includes a start and replay flow, score and shard counters, a flux bonus, and a saved personal best.

I assumed a three-lane endless-dodger game. Verified the game and touch controls in a 390×844 mobile viewport; JavaScript syntax checks passed. To run it locally, serve the repository with any static file server.
